displayName: Accessibility Conect - Wi-Fi and Bluetooth of Windows with NVDA
description: Press NVDA+Alt+K to open an accessible window with what the Windows Settings offer for Wi-Fi and Bluetooth. Wi-Fi: turn it on and off, search and connect to networks (with password, hidden networks), disconnect, see the details of the connection, forget saved networks, metered connection, random hardware addresses and the password of a saved network. Bluetooth: turn it on and off, see the paired devices with their battery, add and pair devices (every kind of code), connect, disconnect, rename and remove them, send and receive files. Connections, weak signal, missing internet, low battery and devices ready to pair are announced even with the window closed. The lists change only when you search again.

translations.displayName: Accessibility Conect - Wi-Fi e Bluetooth do Windows com o NVDA
translations.description: Pressione NVDA+Alt+K para abrir uma janela acessível com o que as Configurações do Windows oferecem para o Wi-Fi e o Bluetooth. Wi-Fi: ligar e desligar, buscar e conectar redes (com senha, redes ocultas), desconectar, ver os detalhes da conexão, esquecer redes salvas, conexão limitada, endereços de hardware aleatórios e a senha de uma rede salva. Bluetooth: ligar e desligar, ver os dispositivos pareados com a bateria, adicionar e parear dispositivos (todos os tipos de código), conectar, desconectar, renomear e remover, enviar e receber arquivos. Conexões, sinal fraco, falta de internet, bateria fraca e dispositivos prontos para parear são anunciados mesmo com a janela fechada. As listas só mudam quando você busca de novo.
